nodes.label: SOLID C# Engineering
nodes.rationale: The repository mission is evidence-based SOLID improvement with behavior preservation, explicit boundaries, and executable verification.

nodes.label: Baseline Verification
nodes.rationale: Pre-existing failures must be established before edits so they are not attributed to a refactor.

nodes.label: Minimal Reversible Refactoring
nodes.rationale: Refactors should be small, ordered, reversible, and limited to abstractions with demonstrated need.

nodes.label: Behavioral Substitutability
nodes.rationale: Inheritance and interface shape are insufficient evidence; contracts, clients, and meaningful behavior determine SOLID findings.

nodes.label: C# Async Iterators Compatibility
nodes.rationale: The package backports async-iterator definitions to .NET Framework and .NET Standard 2.0 and is unnecessary on platforms that already provide them.

nodes.label: Inversion of Control
nodes.rationale: Dependency injection is presented as a technique for achieving inversion of control between classes and their dependencies.

nodes.label: Euclidean Affine Functions and Applications to Calendar Algorithms
nodes.author: Cassio Neri and Lorenz Schneider
nodes.norm_label: euclidean affine functions and applications to calendar algorithms

nodes.label: Separation of Engineering Stages
nodes.rationale: Discovery, auditing, planning, implementation, and verification are separated so auditors remain read-only and only the implementer changes production code.

nodes.label: Behavior-Preserving SOLID Changes
nodes.rationale: A modification is accepted only when it reduces demonstrated risk, preserves contracts, and leaves verifiable evidence.

nodes.label: Stable Abstraction
nodes.rationale: A proposed abstraction should be more stable than its implementations, benefit a real client or boundary, and simplify a concrete change scenario.

nodes.label: One Writer Policy
nodes.rationale: Parallel writers can introduce conflicting abstractions and ambiguous verification, so only refactor-implementer writes production code.

nodes.label: Independent SOLID Audits
nodes.rationale: Each SOLID principle requires distinct evidence, while a generic review tends to collapse them into vague clean-code commentary.
